candidates.summary: with cors_allowed_origins = [] a page served from the node's own public origin through a Host-rewriting reverse proxy is refused on /websocket
candidates.failure_scenario: node.go:951 passes nil when CORS is disabled, so handlers.go:1139 leaves gorilla's same-origin check, which compares the Origin host with the Host the node receives. nginx's proxy_pass default rewrites Host to the upstream, so Origin https://rpc.example.com meets Host 127.0.0.1:26657 and gets 403. Needs the non-default [] list; the default ["*"] is unaffected.
candidates.verify_by: go test -run TestJudgeR1_ProxyHost ./tm2/pkg/bft/rpc/lib/server at head and at the merge base via -overlay
candidates.evidence: head: proxy_keeps_host 101, proxy_rewrites_host 403 'websocket: bad handshake'; merge base (overlay, constructor without origins): both 101, PASS
